title_ar: الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين يستقبل الوفد الأفغاني المفاوض في الدوحة
title_en: The International Union of Muslim Scholars Receives the Afghan Negotiating Delegation in Doha
body_ar:
شارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن اليوم 01 اكتوبر 2020م رفقة كل من الدكتور احمد الريسوني رئيس الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين و أمينه العام الدكتور علي القرة داغي في استقبال وفد حركة طالبان المشارك في حوار الدوحة بين الحركة وحكومة أفغانستان والولايات المتحدة

وقد تحدث الشيخ في اللقاء عن ضرورة حقن الدماء والعمل ضمن المشترك في صالح بناء دولة أفغانستان وتغليب منطق الحكمة دون أن يكون في ذلك خنوع أو إذلال

وذكر بدماء الأمة النازفة في شتى البقاع والحملة على الدين الإسلامي وأهله وما ينبغي أن يسعى له الغيورون من وقوف في وجه الهجمات بالمستطاع والممكن دون إفراط ولا تفريط

وختم بأهمية دور الهيئات العلمائية وعلى رأسها الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين في لم شمل وجمع كلمة كل الأطراف في دولة أفغانستان وغيرها من بلاد المسلمين.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan took part today, 1 October 2020, together with Dr Ahmad al-Raysuni, president of the International Union of Muslim Scholars, and its secretary-general Dr Ali al-Qaradaghi, in receiving the delegation of the Taliban movement taking part in the Doha talks between the movement, the government of Afghanistan and the United States.

At the meeting the Sheikh spoke of the need to stop the shedding of blood and to work within what is held in common, for the good of building the state of Afghanistan, and to let the logic of wisdom prevail, without this involving any submissiveness or humiliation.

He recalled the blood of the Ummah being shed in many places, and the campaign against the religion of Islam and its people, and what those who are zealous ought to strive for by way of standing against these attacks with what is within their power and capacity, without excess and without negligence.

He closed with the importance of the role of scholarly bodies, foremost among them the International Union of Muslim Scholars, in reuniting and bringing together the word of all parties in the state of Afghanistan and in the other lands of the Muslims.

flags.arabic: في استقبال وفد حركة طالبان المشارك في حوار الدوحة
flags.context: the whole report: a reception held for the Taliban negotiating delegation, with the Sheikh present
options: hold the record from publication pending legal advice in each jurisdiction
publish the report as translated, with a contextual note dating it to the 2020 Doha talks
publish with the organisation named but the report carried only in the Arabic pane
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW, highest exposure in this slice together with record 1074. The report describes the Sheikh taking part in receiving a Taliban delegation. At the date of the report, October 2020, the Taliban were subject to UN and national sanctions regimes and were a proscribed or designated entity in several jurisdictions; the group's status in UK, EU and US law has shifted since and differs between them. An English page reporting participation in a reception for that delegation could raise questions under sanctions and counter-terrorism law that are legal, not editorial. The translation is faithful and has been neither softened nor strengthened: حقن الدماء is 'stopping the shedding of blood', خنوع أو إذلال is 'submissiveness or humiliation', and the reported remarks are a call to negotiate, not to fight. The context — that this was a reception for a delegation to internationally sponsored peace talks in Doha at which the United States was a party — is material and should be displayed with it. The publication decision belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office, with legal advice, and must never be taken by default.

flags.arabic: وقوف في وجه الهجمات بالمستطاع والممكن دون إفراط ولا تفريط
flags.context: وما ينبغي أن يسعى له الغيورون من وقوف في وجه الهجمات بالمستطاع والممكن
options: standing against these attacks with what is within their power and capacity (the neutral reading used here)
resisting these attacks by whatever means are available
flags.note: وقوف في وجه is 'standing against' or 'standing up to' and is not a term for armed action; بالمستطاع والممكن is 'with what is possible and within one's capacity', and دون إفراط ولا تفريط, 'without excess and without negligence', qualifies it in the direction of restraint. The second rendering would read in English as a call to unspecified means and would strengthen the Arabic. The context is the campaign against Islam mentioned in the same sentence, i.e. it is not tied to Afghanistan. Recorded because the passage would carry weight in any legal reading of the page.

translator_notes: الغيورون are those possessed of zeal or protective jealousy for the religion; rendered 'those who are zealous'. 'The jealous' would be a false friend in English.
لم شمل وجمع كلمة is a fixed pair — reuniting people and bringing their word together, i.e. reconciling factions. Rendered literally because both halves are idiomatic in Arabic reporting of this kind.
A news report. It states no ruling and engages no legal category, so the five-rulings mapping of style guide section 3 is not in play.
اكتوبر is written without hamzah in the source (for أكتوبر). Preserved in body_ar.

The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload/publication stamp, not the date on which the Sheikh gave the answer. Records across this slice carry timestamps clustered minutes apart on the same day (e.g. 1038/1039/1040 at 08:13/08:14/08:14 on 8 August 2019; 1077/1078/1079 at 09:50/09:52/09:53 on 22 July 2020), which is the signature of a batch upload. date_is_cms_upload is therefore set true throughout.
dec: Reports participation in a reception for a Taliban delegation at a date when the group was subject to sanctions and designation regimes.
